title: Configuration Management
description: Configuration Management as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is the FDPS allocated a number, owning Sub-team and lead Sub-system?
Are all items in the FDPS population linked to a Part Definition?
Is the planned effectivity of the FDPS recorded?
Are Part, Assembly and FDPS numbers allocated under the numbering rules (stem, dash range, handedness)?
Are revisions and effectivity ranges for every item recorded with no gaps or overlaps?
Are changes since the last review recorded as Change Records?
Does the release baseline resolve every member to exactly one revision at every effectivity?
Are superseded definitions and non-interchangeable changes numbered by the roll-by-two rule?
Are all Review Flags on the FDPS dispositioned?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
